name: Infatuation Inferno
source:
One year ago, you saved a man from burning to death.

Now, on the anniversary, a fire is started in your front yard and that very same man shows up on your doorstep.

It all has to be a coincidence, right?

[From [url=https://punkin-pictures.itch.io/infatuation-inferno]itch.io[/url]]
